mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, type, title, content, is_read) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
